title: THE UNMADE — Canonical Game Codex
goal: One canonical rule/dependency ledger for abilities, enemies, crafting, experience, skills, realms, journeys, quests, rewards and consequences.
authority: Canonical whole-game design and requirements authoring ledger. Migrated study and Atlas checklist strings are generated into C++; live source rule models still execute and enforce the save state. Other mirrored domains require source-parity checks until individually migrated. Do not claim all gameplay runtime rules are Codex-driven yet.
